title: Too expensive
en:
I completely understand — fees are a big decision, and you should feel sure. 🙏

A few things that help:
• No-cost EMI on fees above ₹15,000 — pay monthly
• Online live classes cost less (with recordings)
• Save up to 20% with on-the-spot, group or seasonal offers (T&C apply)

Best of all, attend a free demo first and decide only if it feels worth it.
hi:
Bilkul samajh sakte hain — fees ek bada decision hai, aur aapko poora bharosa hona chahiye. 🙏

Ye cheezein help karti hain:
• ₹15,000 se upar ki fees par no-cost EMI — mahine ke hisaab se do
• Online live classes ki fees kam hai (recordings ke saath)
• On-the-spot, group ya seasonal offer mein 20% tak bachat (T&C apply)

Sabse achha — pehle free demo dekho, worth lage tabhi decide karo.

🏫 Classroom at Ajmer Road — face-to-face practice
💻 Online live — the same live class from our digital board, a recording of every class, and a lower fee

title: Online vs classroom
en:
Both give you the same course, same trainer and the same live class 👍

🏫 Classroom (Ajmer Road): face-to-face practice, learn alongside your batch, ask doubts on the spot. Best if you're in or near Jaipur.
💻 Online live: join from home, ask doubts live, get a recording of every class, and pay a lower fee. Best if you're outside Jaipur, working, or short on time.

Still unsure? Try a free demo in either mode.
hi:
Dono mein course, trainer aur live class same hai 👍

🏫 Classroom (Ajmer Road): aamne-saamne practice, batch ke saath seekhna, doubt turant clear. Jaipur ya paas rehte ho to best.
💻 Online live: ghar se join, live doubt poochna, har class ki recording, aur fees bhi kam. Jaipur ke bahar ho, job karte ho ya time kam hai to best.

Abhi bhi confuse? Kisi bhi mode mein free demo try karo.

en:
Please don't worry about that at all. 🙏 Many of our students come from Hindi-medium schools.

Classes are in Hindi and simple English, we start from the basics, and nobody in class laughs at anyone. You'll be comfortable from day one.

Iski bilkul tension mat lijiye. 🙏 Humare bahut saare students Hindi medium se hain.

Classes Hindi aur simple English mein hoti hain, basics se shuru karte hain, aur class mein koi kisi par hansta nahi. Pehle din se aap comfortable feel karoge.

en:
YouTube is great for learning what to do — we use it too! 😊

What it can't give you: a trainer who checks your work, live practice, a batch that keeps you going, a portfolio reviewed by experts, an internship option and placement assistance.

Most of our students tried YouTube first — they join for the practice and the push.

YouTube kya karna hai seekhne ke liye badhiya hai — hum bhi use karte hain! 😊

Good that you're comparing! 👍 Ask every institute the same 3 questions:
1. How many minutes will I personally practise in each class?
2. What will I build that I can show an employer?
3. Is there an internship option and placement assistance?

Compare those, not just the fee — and sit in our free demo before you decide.

Achha hai aap compare kar rahe ho! 👍 Har institute se ye 3 sawaal poochiye:
1. Har class mein main khud kitni der practice karunga?

3. Internship option aur placement assistance hai?

Sirf fees nahi, ye compare kijiye — aur decide karne se pehle humara free demo dekhiye.

title: Batch size
en: Batches are kept small — about 12–15 students — so the trainer knows every student and checks everyone's work.
hi: Batch chhote rakhte hain — lagbhag 12–15 students — taaki trainer har student ko jaane aur sabka kaam check kare.
notes: Section 9 "Batch size" row. Fact: 12–15 students. Buttons are the standard FAQ buttons (Section 9: every answer is followed by Book free demo · Ask another · Main menu; Hinglish labels from FAQ_MATCH).

title: Payment methods
en: You can pay at the centre or by bank transfer; online students get the payment details by phone. You get a receipt every time.
hi: Payment centre par ya bank transfer se kar sakte ho; online students ko payment details phone par mil jaati hain. Har baar receipt milti hai.
notes: Section 9 "Payment" row. Buttons are the standard FAQ buttons (Section 9: every answer is followed by Book free demo · Ask another · Main menu; Hinglish labels from FAQ_MATCH).

title: Two courses together
en: Yes! Complementary pairs work really well — Graphic Design + Video Editing, or SEO + Content Writing — and a package costs less than separate courses. Your counsellor will suggest a combination that won't overload your week.
hi: Haan! Saath chalne wale courses best rehte hain — Graphic Design + Video Editing, ya SEO + Content Writing — aur package alag-alag se sasta padta hai. Counsellor aisa combination batayenge jo aapke hafte par zyada load na daale.
notes: Section 9 "Two courses together" row. Course names are Infonic catalogue-specific. Buttons are the standard FAQ buttons (Section 9: every answer is followed by Book free demo · Ask another · Main menu; Hinglish labels from FAQ_MATCH).

title: Switch course / batch
en: First, our free counselling helps you pick the right course. If you join and the course genuinely doesn't suit you, talk to us early — we'll work out a solution with you. (College internships: domain change is possible in the first week.)
hi: Pehle free counselling se sahi course chunne mein help karte hain. Join karne ke baad course sach mein suit na kare to jaldi batao — hum saath milkar solution nikalenge. (College internship mein pehle hafte domain change ho sakta hai.)
notes: Section 9 "Switch course" row. Buttons are the standard FAQ buttons (Section 9: every answer is followed by Book free demo · Ask another · Main menu; Hinglish labels from FAQ_MATCH).

title: Doubts & support
en: Doubt support is part of your fee — ask in class anytime, and book one-to-one doubt sessions with your mentor. After the course, placement help continues: resume, LinkedIn, interview prep and job openings.
hi: Doubt support fees mein included hai — class mein kabhi bhi poocho, aur mentor ke saath one-to-one doubt session lo. Course ke baad bhi placement help chalti rehti hai: resume, LinkedIn, interview prep aur job openings.
notes: Section 9 "Doubts & support" row. Buttons are the standard FAQ buttons (Section 9: every answer is followed by Book free demo · Ask another · Main menu; Hinglish labels from FAQ_MATCH).

title: Exams & assessment
en: There's no separate exam fee. You're assessed through assignments and projects, and your trainer gives detailed feedback. The final assessment also decides internship eligibility.
hi: Alag se exam fees nahi hai. Assignments aur projects se assessment hota hai, aur trainer detailed feedback dete hain. Final assessment se internship eligibility bhi tay hoti hai.
notes: Section 9 "Exams" row (keywords cell reads "exam, test, pass fail, assessment" — split into separate words). Buttons are the standard FAQ buttons (Section 9: every answer is followed by Book free demo · Ask another · Main menu; Hinglish labels from FAQ_MATCH).

title: Training letter for college
en: You get a completion certificate plus a training letter and attendance record on our company letterhead, with seal and signature — accepted by most Rajasthan colleges. Do check the format your department wants.
hi: Completion certificate ke saath company letterhead par training letter aur attendance record milta hai, seal aur signature ke saath — Rajasthan ke zyadatar colleges accept karte hain. Apne department se format zaroor check kar lijiye.
notes: Contains Infonic-specific facts: "Rajasthan colleges". Buttons are the standard FAQ buttons (Section 9: every answer is followed by Book free demo · Ask another · Main menu; Hinglish labels from FAQ_MATCH).

title: College internship hours
en: College internships run 3 weeks to 6 months. Online takes about 3–4 hours a day, offline 4–5 hours a day at the centre (winter offline slots: 10 am–2 pm or 2–6 pm). You need 75% attendance for the certificate.
hi: College internship 3 hafte se 6 mahine tak. Online mein roz lagbhag 3–4 ghante, offline centre par 4–5 ghante (winter offline slot: 10–2 ya 2–6 baje). Certificate ke liye 75% attendance zaroori hai.
notes: Section 9 "College internship hours" row. Buttons are the standard FAQ buttons (Section 9: every answer is followed by Book free demo · Ask another · Main menu; Hinglish labels from FAQ_MATCH).

title: Homemakers / career restart
en: Absolutely! Many homemakers have trained with us. Digital marketing, content writing, video editing and social media work well — timings can fit around your home, and online live is an option too. A career gap doesn't count against you.
hi: Bilkul! Bahut si homemakers humare saath training le chuki hain. Digital marketing, content writing, video editing aur social media achhe options hain — timing ghar ke hisaab se, aur online live bhi. Career gap koi problem nahi.
notes: Section 9 "Homemakers" row. Buttons are the standard FAQ buttons (Section 9: every answer is followed by Book free demo · Ask another · Main menu; Hinglish labels from FAQ_MATCH).

hi: Course par depend karta hai: Video Editing mein saare systems aur software centre par milte hain; Digital Marketing aur AI & ML ke liye apna normal laptop chahiye (AI ke liye 8 GB RAM kaafi hai — heavy kaam free Google Colab par). Aapke course ke liye counsellor bata denge. {{lab_policy}}

notes: Section 13 draft — fill {{women_safety}} before going live. Buttons are the standard FAQ buttons (Section 9: every answer is followed by Book free demo · Ask another · Main menu; Hinglish labels from FAQ_MATCH).

title: Recording access
en: Online classes run live on Zoom or Google Meet, and online students get a recording of every class. Recordings stay available for {{recording_access}}. (Positive Mindset coaching sessions are private and not recorded.)

title: Course internship length
en: Internships happen in the office or remotely, depending on the role, on real projects reviewed by our team. After a course, the internship usually runs {{course_intern_duration}}. Whether it carries a stipend depends on your interview and performance.
